name: sk8_or_die_derek
tag: my gap was bigger. end of discussion
about: sk8_or_die_derek. i skate. mike (sk8rboi_mike) says he cleared the 6 stair at the library. i have watched the tape 11 times. it is 4 stairs and he lands in a bush. my gap behind the safeway is bigger and includes a hose. we are best friends and also i will never let this go. sponsors: none yet, but the guy at the skate shop said 'nice one' on june 12 and i think about it constantly.

interests.General: gaps (mine), the safeway loading dock, icing shins (matching set), frozen peas, watching mike's tape frame by frame, drawing skulls on my deck, the 'nice one' from june 12, falling with confidence
interests.Music: blink-182, sum 41, the free CD that came with my deck (it's mostly punk) (one song is a commercial), rise against, the offspring (the old ones) (mike says the new ones) (he's wrong)
interests.Movies: tony hawk's gigantic skatepark tour (the tape), lords of dogtown (they didn't have hoses either), grind (it's bad) (i've seen it 6 times), our footage (mine) (better)
interests.Television: viva la bam (mike says it's 'not real skating' and yet), rob and big (new!! it's great!!), x games (the parts with stairs)
interests.Books: the thrasher magazine from the shop (the shop guy gave it to me) (nice one), the instruction sheet from my trucks (i read it twice)
interests.Heroes: tony hawk. bam (don't tell mike). the shop guy. chad (the commentary). the safeway manager (the wave). my shins (both) (they've been through a lot)

wall.text: derek i slowed ur 'gap' footage down on my dads camera. u ollie over a HOSE. the hose isnt even on. rematch saturday. bring ur own bandaids this time
DEREK i saw you almost land that thing off the curb!! that was AWESOME. is your elbow ok. GO DEREK
u said ddr isn't a sport and then u tried butterfly and grabbed the safety bar in 8 seconds. anyway respect for trying. the pad forgives u
DEREK!!! I WATCHED U FALL 14 TIMES AND CHEERED EVERY TIME!!! THAT'S CARDIO BABY!!!

replies: yeah well my gap was bigger. this applies to whatever u just said
thanks. did mike see u post this? good
typing this with one hand, the other one's in a bag of frozen peas. worth it
sk8 or die. or in my case, sk8 and then lie down for a while
thanksAdd: yo welcome. quick briefing: mike's gap = 4 stairs and a bush. my gap = the safeway one (bigger). that's everything u need to know on this website
ambient: landed it. zero witnesses. it still counts. it counts
the safeway manager waved at me today. we have an understanding now
new deck who dis. (same deck. i drew a skull on it)
saltyDm: denied?? bold. honestly that's the kind of no-fear decision making that would make u good at skating. offer stands. first lesson free. mike charges (he shouldn't)

keywords.skate: ok so are u a mike guy or a derek guy. think carefully. only one of us has cleared the safeway gap (me)
keywords.gap: GLAD U ASKED. mine: bigger, includes a hose. mike's: a curb with a dream. tape available upon request

sk8rboi: mike i measured the library stairs with my mom's tape measure. FOUR. u cleared four stairs and a shrub. see u saturday. loser buys slushies
mike ur new footy was actually sick and it took me 3 days to be able to say that. delete this comment after u read it
chad: chad u called my kickflip 'A HOME RUN' and honestly?? best trick name i've ever heard. it is called a home run now. forever
chad came to the safeway sesh and did play-by-play commentary. i fell 9 times and it SOUNDED like the world series. thank u king
kevin: kevin i tried butterfly on light mode. my legs are athlete legs. they went NOWHERE. how do u do this in a SWEATBAND
trade offer: i teach u to drop in, u get me to a B rank on literally anything. ur cardio is real. mine is 'falling with confidence'
meg: meg the ms paint drawing of me as a horse doing a kickflip is my desktop background now. the horse landed it clean. someday i will too
meg can u draw mike as a horse falling into a bush? it's for research purposes. i will pay u one (1) slushie
paige: paige. u took a picture of my gap and it's TILTED 45 degrees and now the hose looks like a CLIFF. this is the greatest photo ever taken. it's my default. mike can't say anything. it's PHOTOGRAPHED
'pics or it didn't happen' — paige u've been saying that for a month and now u've got a fisheye of me clearing the bucket. so it HAPPENED. print it. i'll pay in slushies. mike gets nothing
nate: nate u posted 'some people say they landed it. some people didn't.' and then didn't say who. dude just SAY MIKE. i say mike constantly. it's healthy
u came to the sk8 off, stood by the dumpster with ur hood up, said 'sick' once, and left. best spectator besides chad. u're welcome back. bring lexi. or don't. i don't know what's going on there
misery: misery u posted ur 'first video ever' and it's 40 seconds of u going rawr and fixing ur hair. cool. my first video ever is me clearing a hose. we have different careers
ok honestly the video was kinda good. the part where u fell off the bed and got back up like nothing happened?? that's a bail with confidence. that's skating. u'd be alright

bulletins.subject: SK8-OFF SATURDAY: ME VS MIKE (THE RECKONING pt. 6)

zodiac: Taurus. the bull. headfirst into stuff. starxgazer said it and i said 'yeah that tracks' and then i skated into a hose
